subject: Creating a data frame inside if statement

messages.author: f5207db12d701abb
messages.subject: Creating a data frame inside if statement
parts:
am trying to create a data frame within the if statement , but when i use this data frame in the else scope i get the following error:

Error: $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

here is part of my code:

if (i == 1){
  parameters <- c(Qin=Qin,A=A)
  state <- c(h=h0)
  time <- seq(0,200,by=1)
  out <- ode(y= state, func = FluidH, parms = parameters, times = time)
  Qout <- cbind(out[,1],VFRoutput((out[,2])))
  colnames(Qout)<-c("time","Qout")
  Qin <- as.data.frame(Qout)
  #write.csv(Qin,"Qin")
}
else{
  print(Qin$Qout)

i tried to make Qin global with the "<<-" operator but when i tried to print Qin$Qout from the if statement i got the same error

any solutions?

messages.author: 91bee2fcb8329b57
messages.subject: Re: Creating a data frame inside if statement
parts:
You can't create a variable inside an if statement, and then use it outside, if the if was false.
A simple solution is to create this variable before the if statement, but without any initialization:

Qin <- data.frame(Qout = as.numeric(NULL), time = as.numeric(NULL))



This would give you a empty data frame, on which you can still call:

print(Qin$Qout)
